text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
H-How tragic... My moe moe Three Great 
Unifiers of Sengoku are ruined...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, Hishi Miracle-san, and 
Dants-san. Usually all three of you grace 
us with your presence, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Only one person today... To think I can't 
see the giant-killing match~. *sob sob 
sob*...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I only hope this is limited to just 
today.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps those days when the three of us 
ran together with reckless abandon—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Perhaps she will never return.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Time is... a merciless thing. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I cannot simply sheath this blade now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's opponents are Symboli Kris S and 
Agnes Digital. Symboli Kris S in 
particular is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The most formidable of formidable foes. 
Back when all three of us could train 
together, I could still put up a fight, 
but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Kris S, today thy familiar 
countenance is...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"It looms as massive as a great fortress. 
Now then, how ought I lay siege to it?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "I haven't changed. I――will never change."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The one who changed—is you, No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That is correct. To be precise, it 
wasn't me who changed, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Look around me. No one runs carrying that 
same dream anymore.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I came to see for myself 
today.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Can I pull off an upset all by myself?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: All alone... really?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye! Nya-ha-ha, do not underestimate me! I 
may not look it, but I am an Umamusume who 
has led the charge across countless 
battlefields!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I no longer need comrades-in-arms. 
That is why, today—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I shall put it to the test! Whether I 
truly stand a chance against you all on my 
own or not!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmph—Then come at me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you on. I shall—meet your 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I, too, shall humbly accept! With great 
pleasure, bowing low~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason throws down the gauntlet with 
fierce confidence. Half of it was genuine, 
but the other half—was pure bluff.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, Trainer. And you watch too, 
Dantsu-dono, Miracle.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: My――stubborn pride!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A contest that will decide their future 
path begins!
